desc: Derive and prove the feasibility condition for a fixed number of pairs \(K\), including why the K smallest and K largest mochi suffice.
Implement binary search on \(K \in [0,\lfloor N/2\rfloor]\) with the monotonic fixed-K feasibility predicate.
Verify equality, duplicate sizes, zero feasible pairs, and maximum-pair cases.
Use efficient Python stdin parsing and stdout output.
